mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 2% INDPRO drop.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise and consumer spending is already high, it signals an overextended economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% in 3 months and RSAFS > $400B
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances with rising HOUST and high RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and falling, it signals a tight labor market that will boost wage growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months with falling UNRATE below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and inflation is already high, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods with rising FEDFUNDS and high CPI.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP is growing and consumer spending is accelerating, it signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances with rising GDPC1 and accelerating RSAFS.
